tasks.short: Close the month: run payroll period reports in AFAS, tie net pay and tax payments to Rabobank.

today.trigger: Payroll run approved and Rabobank payment batch executed, usually around the 25th
steps: Export period journal, net pay list and loonheffing totals from AFAS Profit
Download Rabobank statement and payment batch confirmation
Match net pay per employee and totals to bank debits in Excel
Chase differences (rejected IBANs, manual payments, advances)
Send balanced period report to Controller
drudgery: Copying exports into the same Excel template each month
Ticking off hundreds of lines by hand
today.time_sinks: Finding the few lines that do not match, such as returned payments or off-cycle payments made outside the batch.

lenses.faster: A scripted match of the AFAS payment file to the Rabobank CAMT.053 statement removes the export, copy and tick-off steps; only real differences remain.
lenses.autonomous: When the bank statement comes in after the pay date, the reconciliation runs and posts a balanced report or an exception list to Teams.
lenses.ambitious: Reconcile every off-cycle run and every agency payment the same day, not just the monthly close.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses ticking 1,200 lines; investigating the odd returned payment is what stays.
lenses.options: Show matches at employee, cost centre and site level so the Controller can choose the view that fits the close.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the matching rules and tolerance thresholds and reviews the exception log, not the lines.
reach: Accountant: payroll journal and accrual posting for month close
Bookkeeper: bank statement matching for payroll-related lines

tasks.human_edge: Judging why a payment bounced or a manual advance was made, and deciding the correction with the employee and Finance.
tasks.pattern_why: Both sides are structured files with exact amounts and IBANs; matching rules can be written down and the output checked to the cent.

in_practice.trigger: Rabobank statement for the pay date is available
steps: Pull the AFAS SEPA payment file and period journal
Import the Rabobank CAMT.053 statement
Match on IBAN, amount and reference; flag returns and unmatched lines
Produce the balanced period report and an exception list
Specialist resolves exceptions and signs off
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist signs off the exception list before the report goes to the Controller.
data_needed: AFAS payment file and period journal
List of off-cycle and manual payments
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint close folder per period, with match results and sign-off

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit imports bank statements and can match lines automatically.
evidence.source: AFAS Profit (bank statement import and automatic matching)

evidence.claim: Rabobank offers CAMT.053 statement downloads usable for automated reconciliation.

risks: Rules that auto-clear a wrong match hide an error
Salary data in exports leaves AFAS and must stay access-controlled under AVG
research_questions: How many unmatched lines per month are there today, and what causes them?
Does Noordhaven already use AFAS bank matching for the payroll account or only for AP/AR?
Can the Controller accept an exception-only report as close evidence for the auditor?

tasks.short: Run monthly and four-weekly payroll in AFAS, check it, release payslips and the payment batch.

today.trigger: Payroll calendar cut-off after mutations and hours are in
steps: Check mutations from HR (new hires, exits, contract changes) and shift hours
Run the trial payroll in AFAS Profit
Compare to last period and investigate large changes
Run the final payroll and send the SEPA batch to Rabobank
Publish payslips in AFAS InSite/Pocket
drudgery: Scanning variance lists line by line
Re-checking ORT and overtime hours entered late
today.time_sinks: Explaining variances for 750 shift workers whose allowances change each period.

lenses.faster: An automated variance check explains most changes from the mutation and hours data, so only unexplained differences need a look.
lenses.autonomous: The trial run triggers itself at cut-off and posts a variance report; the specialist approves the final run.
lenses.ambitious: Check every payslip against the CAO and contract before release, not just the outliers.
lenses.joy: Less scanning of lists; more time on the employees with a real problem.
lenses.options: Present the run with a risk score per employee so the specialist picks which ten to check by hand.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the variance rules and the release checklist instead of eyeballing every line.
reach: HR Administrator: checking mutation quality before cut-off
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: spotting allowances that drift from the CAO

tasks.human_edge: Accountability for releasing pay, and judgement on unusual cases such as garnishments (loonbeslag) or disputed hours.
tasks.pattern_why: Several steps across AFAS and the bank with exceptions; payment must not leave without a person approving.

in_practice.trigger: Payroll cut-off date reached in AFAS
steps: Run trial payroll and pull mutations and hours
Explain variances against last period from source changes
Flag unexplained or high-risk lines with a short reason
Specialist reviews flags and approves the final run
Release SEPA batch and payslips
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves the final run; second signature on the Rabobank batch by Finance.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS run log plus a variance review file per period on SharePoint

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit runs Dutch payroll and publishes payslips digitally in InSite and the Pocket app.
Automated variance explanation from mutation data is feasible with scripts on AFAS exports.

risks: Over-trust in the variance check lets a systematic error through
Late hours from shift systems break the cut-off
research_questions: What share of variance lines today are fully explained by mutations or hours?
How many payroll errors reached employees in the last year, and how were they caught?
Is four-eight-weekly and monthly payroll run separately for warehouse and office staff?

tasks.short: Make labour cost and pay reports for Finance, managers, the OR and CBS surveys.

today.trigger: Month close, quarter end, or a request from Finance, a manager or the works council
steps: Pull pay components from AFAS or the Power BI extract
Group by site, cost centre, own staff and flex
Build tables in Excel and add short comments
Send to Finance, site managers or the OR
drudgery: Rebuilding the same pivot each month
Answering one-off questions with a new spreadsheet
today.time_sinks: Ad hoc requests that each need a fresh cut of the data.

lenses.faster: Standard reports become Power BI pages refreshed nightly, and an LLM drafts the commentary from the numbers.
lenses.autonomous: Reports publish after close and go to the right recipients with role-based access.
lenses.ambitious: Give site managers monthly labour cost against budget, including flex, which is now quarterly at best.
lenses.joy: No more rebuilding pivots; explaining what the numbers mean stays.
lenses.options: Draft three commentary angles (cost driver, overtime, flex share) and let the specialist pick.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the report set and its definitions and checks the numbers once at source.
reach: FP&A Analyst: labour cost actual versus budget
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: pay data marts in Power BI

tasks.human_edge: Knowing which figures are sensitive (individual pay, OR requests) and how to frame them.
tasks.pattern_why: Data is structured in AFAS; reports are fixed queries with checkable totals; commentary is a small LLM add-on.

in_practice.trigger: Payroll period closed in AFAS and nightly extract refreshed
steps: Refresh Power BI labour cost model
Check totals tie to the payroll journal
Draft commentary with an LLM from variance figures
Specialist edits and publishes
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist reviews totals and commentary before external or OR distribution.
in_practice.logs_to: Power BI workspace history and SharePoint report archive

evidence.claim: Power BI is already refreshed nightly from AFAS at Noordhaven.
Copilot in Power BI can draft narrative summaries of report data.

risks: Individual salary data exposed by wrong row-level security (AVG)
Generated commentary states a cause that is not true
research_questions: Which reports are produced monthly and which are ad hoc, and how many hours each?
Do site managers want labour cost monthly, and would they use it?
What does the OR require for the annual social report?

tasks.short: Balance payroll ledger accounts: net pay, loonheffing, pension and other payables in AFAS.

steps: List balances on payroll intermediate accounts in AFAS
Compare to payroll journal and payments made
Trace open items such as unpaid pension premiums or garnishments
Post corrections and document the balance
drudgery: Rolling forward the same reconciliation sheet
today.time_sinks: Old small differences that carry over months.

lenses.faster: A rule-based check compares each payroll account to its expected balance from journal and payments and lists only the gaps.
lenses.autonomous: The check runs nightly in close week and warns when an account does not clear.
lenses.ambitious: Keep every payroll account at zero difference every month, with an audit trail.
lenses.joy: Gone: chasing EUR 3 differences from last spring.
lenses.options: Suggest likely causes for each gap ranked by past patterns.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the account map and clearing rules, reviewing exceptions only.
reach: Accountant: balance sheet reconciliation of payroll accounts

tasks.human_edge: Deciding how to correct and who to tell when a difference is real money owed.
tasks.pattern_why: Balances, journals and payments are structured and the expected balance can be calculated.

steps: Read balances on payroll accounts
Calculate expected balance from journal and bank
List gaps with likely cause
Specialist posts corrections and signs off

evidence.claim: Account reconciliation tools automate balance checks against subledgers.
The same can be scripted on AFAS exports at this company's scale.

risks: Rules that net out differences hide errors
Mapping breaks when the chart of accounts changes
research_questions: How many payroll accounts exist and how many have carried-over differences?
Does the auditor require documented reconciliations per account?
Who owns these accounts today: payroll or Finance?

tasks.short: Correct pay errors and process retroactive CAO increases in AFAS.

today.trigger: Employee complaint, HR mutation error, or a new CAO with retroactive pay rise
steps: Find the error or read the new CAO terms
Determine affected employees and periods
Enter corrections or run retroactive recalculation in AFAS
Check results and explain to the employee
drudgery: Recalculating periods by hand to check AFAS
Translating CAO text into scale tables
today.time_sinks: Retroactive CAO increases across many shift workers and changed allowances.

lenses.faster: An LLM reads the CAO text into proposed scale and allowance changes, AFAS recalculates, and a script checks the difference per employee.
lenses.autonomous: Once a CAO change is approved, the recalculation and check list run on their own.
lenses.ambitious: Find errors before employees do by checking each run against contract and CAO rules.
lenses.joy: Less hand-checking of back pay; explaining fixes to people stays.
lenses.options: Show the effect of payment in one lump versus spread over periods, including tax effect.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the CAO-to-AFAS parameter process and reviews the checks.
reach: Compensation and Benefits Specialist: CAO scale maintenance
HR Business Partner: explaining corrections to managers

tasks.human_edge: Interpreting ambiguous CAO clauses and talking with employees who were underpaid.
tasks.pattern_why: Mixed text and structured data across steps, with liability; a person approves before any pay changes.

in_practice.trigger: New CAO published or correction request logged
steps: Extract changes from CAO text into a parameter proposal
Specialist approves parameters
Run AFAS retroactive recalculation in a test run
Script checks expected versus actual per employee
Specialist releases in the next payroll
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist approves parameters and the result before release.
in_practice.logs_to: Correction log in AFAS and SharePoint

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports retroactive recalculation of payroll.
LLMs can extract tables and rates from collective agreement text.

risks: Misread CAO clause pays hundreds wrongly
research_questions: How many corrections per month and what causes them?
How long did the last retroactive CAO increase take?
Does the CAO provider publish machine-readable scale tables?

tasks.short: Prepare, check and submit the monthly loonaangifte and corrections to the Belastingdienst.

steps: Generate the loonaangifte in AFAS
Check totals against the payroll journal
Review error messages and corrections
Submit and pay via Rabobank
File the confirmation
drudgery: Checking the same totals each month

lenses.faster: Automated pre-checks compare the return with the journal and last month and flag oddities.
lenses.autonomous: The return is prepared and checked at close, waiting for approval.
lenses.ambitious: Check every return against the UWV polisadministratie data for gaps.
lenses.joy: Less totals checking; the judgement on corrections stays.
lenses.options: Show the cost of correcting now versus with a later return.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the controls and handles notices from the tax office.

tasks.human_edge: Legal accountability and contact with the tax office.
tasks.pattern_why: Several steps with legal liability; a person must approve submission.

steps: Generate return in AFAS
Run checks against journal and prior month
List issues
Specialist approves and submits

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit creates and sends the loonaangifte digitally.

risks: Fines for late or wrong returns
research_questions: How many corrections were filed last year?
How long does the check take now?
What does the auditor require as evidence?

tasks.short: Handle pension fund, UWV and insurance forms and registrations for employees.

today.trigger: New hire, exit, illness, parental leave or a letter from the pension fund or UWV
steps: Read the request or letter
Collect data from AFAS
Fill the form or portal
Check and send
File the result
today.time_sinks: Chasing missing data from HR and employees.

lenses.faster: An LLM reads letters and forms and pre-fills data from AFAS; the specialist checks and sends.
lenses.autonomous: Requests are classified and pre-filled when they come into the mailbox.
lenses.ambitious: Track every UWV benefit claim (Ziektewet, paid parental leave) so no money is missed.
lenses.options: Show which route (UWV, insurer, own risk) fits each case.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs intake rules and checks a queue.
reach: HR Administrator: intake of employee forms
Absence case handling: UWV claims under Wet verbetering poortwachter

tasks.human_edge: Handling sensitive health and family data with care and talking with employees.
tasks.pattern_why: Unstructured letters into structured fields inside a fixed process.

in_practice.trigger: Letter or request lands in the payroll mailbox
steps: Classify and extract fields
Pre-fill from AFAS
Specialist checks and sends
Record result in AFAS
in_practice.human_gate: Specialist checks each form before sending.

evidence.claim: LLMs extract fields from letters and forms.

risks: Health data processed by AI needs AVG basis and a DPIA
Wrong data sent to a fund
research_questions: How many forms per month and which types?
Can the pension fund and UWV portals take file uploads?
Will the OR agree to AI on this data?

role.altitude: From running payroll to owning the payroll control system: rules, checks, exception queues and the evidence that pay, tax and pension are right each period.
reach: Accountant: payroll journal, accruals and payroll account reconciliation
Bookkeeper: matching staffing agency invoices to flex hours
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: CAO scale and allowance maintenance
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: labour cost reporting in Power BI
HR Administrator: checking mutation quality before cut-off
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks are about 480 of 1,600 hours a year; realistic saving is around 270 hours. Legal accountability for pay and tax returns, AVG limits on salary and health data, and works council consent keep a person on every release.
skills_to_grow: Writing and testing reconciliation and variance rules
AFAS Profit configuration and data exports
Reviewing AI output and keeping audit evidence
Reading CAO changes into system parameters
role.ambitious_version: Every payslip checked against contract and CAO before release, every payroll account at zero each month, flex labour cost visible beside own staff, and site managers getting monthly labour cost against budget.
